kitDescription: Snow White: Innocent Days is an Iron AR Attacker whose whole kit runs off hit counters on her normal fire. Every 30 landed normal attacks she gains a stacking Max Ammunition Capacity buff (+25.66% per stack, up to 5 stacks, 5s each) and simultaneously fires a 188.68% ATK damage hit at enemies in range; every 50 landed normal attacks she fires a separate 61.69% ATK hit at all enemies. When she uses her Burst Skill she gains Attack Damage +21.12% for 10 seconds, and the burst itself grants her ATK +97.2% and unlimited ammunition for 10 seconds while also lowering Skill 2's hit requirement by 20 (from 50 to 30) for those 10 seconds. The ammo-capacity stacks and the unlimited-ammo window both keep her firing without reloads, which in turn makes her two hit-counter procs fire more often.

skill1.driverSaid: buff maxAmmoPct 25.66, durationSec 5, maxStacks 5 on hitCount 30, self; measured 67 applies over 180s, cap reached (stacks climb to 5), live arm shows removing it drops shot count and total
skill1.blindSaid: S5: identical encoding expected; pins value/maxStacks/self-scope, non-vacuously requires maxSeen==5, A/B arms vs value-zeroed and maxStacks-raised counterfactuals. S6: identical block.
skill1.formulaCheck: maxAmmoPct scales magazine base×(1+sum/100), refresh-on-reapply adds a stack to cap — encoding matches the SSOT ammo-economy semantics; AR 12 pulls/s puts 30 hits ≈ 2.5s < 5s duration, so the stack-to-5 reading is arithmetically consistent
skill1.explanation: Right trigger (repeating hitCount 30), right stat/value/stacks/duration/scope, and the buff demonstrably fires and binds (shot-count A/B). All three derivations agree.

skill1.kitLine: Deals 188.68% of final ATK as damage
skill1.driverSaid: flatDamage atkPct 188.68 on the same hitCount 30, target enemy; rider frames pinned frame-exact vs an independent 30-hit carry-over walk over her shot events; every-3-hits counterfactual produces >5× riders
skill1.blindSaid: S5: zeroing the rider lowers her total; proc cadence tracks the shared 30-hit trigger; not normal-bucket damage; teammates unmoved. S6: identical block (adds redundant explicit crit:true, the engine default).
skill1.formulaCheck: Rider conventions per SSOT: skill bucket, FB +50% by landing timing (default on), crit-eligible at sheet rate (RIDER_CRIT default), no core (kit says no core strike) — all match; 'enemies within attack range' collapses to the single boss at scope
skill1.explanation: Repeating per-30-hits proc (not one-shot, not interval), correct magnitude and routing; frame-exact independent walk is the strongest available cadence pin.

skill2.kitLine: Deals 61.69% of final ATK as damage
skill2.driverSaid: flatDamage atkPct 61.69 on hitCount 50 + countInFb 30, target enemy; proc schedule pinned frame-exact vs an independent 50/30 carry-over walk; in-window 30-pace procs proven to exist
skill2.blindSaid: S5: zeroing it lowers her total; 50-threshold fires strictly less often than the 30-threshold line (damage-loss ordering ratio ≈5:1 per-hit-rate); teammates unmoved. S6: identical block.
skill2.formulaCheck: hitCount counts landed rounds with carry-over and no reset — matches the prose's repeating 'when landing 50 normal attack(s)'; rider bucket/crit/FB defaults as above. The countInFb component belongs to the burst L5 finding, not this line's base encoding.
skill2.explanation: The base 50-hit repeating trigger is faithful and discriminatingly pinned; the threshold-reduction modifier is assessed on the burst line where the kit places it.

skill2.driverSaid: buff attackDamagePct 21.12, durationSec 10, on burstCast, self; apply frames pinned frame-exact to HER burstCast events; fullBurstEnter counterfactual fires strictly more (helm-led windows)
skill2.blindSaid: S5: apply count == own burstCast count; bucket separation asserted (attackDamagePct 21.12 vs atkPct 97.2 coexist); fullBurstEnter counterfactual over-credits. S6: identical block.
skill2.formulaCheck: 'Attack Damage ▲' is the dmgUp bucket (attackDamagePct), distinct from atkPct — bucket identity load-bearing because her own burst's ATK ▲97.2% composes multiplicatively with it; 'when using Burst Skill' = burstCast, not fullBurstEnter — both correct
skill2.explanation: Correct stat, bucket, trigger identity, scope, and duration; the two-B3 control fixture genuinely exercises the burstCast/fullBurstEnter divergence and the encoding passes.

burst.kitLine: Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼ 20 for 10 sec
burst.driverSaid: Enacted as countInFb 30 on the S2 hitCount (RRH precedent), with a ⚑⚑ caveat: countInFb keys to the GLOBAL FB window, not her cast — over-credits foreign-B3 (helm-led) windows by ~1-2 procs each (~0.5-1% of total), cast-vs-FB anchor off by ~0.3s; exact in single-B3 scope; falsification recipe given (count 61.69% popups in a foreign-B3 FB window — should space at 50); owner-anchored primitive exists only for chargeCounter and S4 froze src/engine/**
burst.blindSaid: S6 blind: independently chose the SAME countInFb:30 encoding with the SAME over-credit ⚑. S5 blind: refused to assert the line at all ('countInFb is FB-scoped, not burst-cast-window-scoped') — an intentional skip flagging the identical primitive gap. S2b pre-op: disposition FIX, predicted exactly this failure mode.
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT confirms: countInFb is keyed to the global FB window (fbEndFrame > frame); the owner-anchored variant exists ONLY for chargeCounter; there is NO owner-anchored hitCount primitive. The engine genuinely cannot express the kit-literal line without a change that was frozen. '▼ 20' = reduce by 20 → 30 (not set-to-20) is correctly read.
burst.explanation: This is a real scope divergence from the kit wording in multi-B3 comps, but it is (a) documented at ⚑⚑ with magnitude bound and falsification recipe, (b) independently converged on by the blind override-writer, (c) independently flagged as unassertable by the blind test-writer, and (d) predicted by the pre-op review. The encoding is the best available under the engine freeze; it is exact at single-B3 scope. Recorded decision, not a silent gotcha.

burst.driverSaid: buff atkPct 97.2, durationSec 10, burstCast, self; apply frames == her burstCast frames; fullBurstEnter counterfactual fires strictly more; live arm removing it drops her total
burst.blindSaid: S5: atkPct 97.2 events once per own cast, 10s window non-vacuity (some damage outside windows), removal lowers her total, teammates identical. S6: identical block.
burst.formulaCheck: atkPct scales base ATK — the distinct bucket from attackDamagePct, so it composes multiplicatively with the 21.12% dmgUp line exactly as the SSOT requires
burst.explanation: Correct stat/bucket/trigger/scope/duration, load-bearing proven by removal arm.

burst.driverSaid: unlimitedAmmo durationSec 10 on burstCast; every in-window shot carries the unlimited flag and ammoAfter never steps down; out-of-window shots drain exactly 1/shot; stripped counterfactual has zero unlimited shots and reloads inside windows
burst.blindSaid: S5: removing it reduces shots fired and total; reload count rises; unlimited flag appears only on her shots. S6: identical block.
burst.formulaCheck: SSOT: in-window shots consume no ammo and don't advance the magazine ordinal; a reload already in flight at cast still completes (driver observed 3× and encoded the jump-up allowance in the assertion) — matches
burst.explanation: Not a one-shot instantReload (the nearest-wrong): full 10s consumption suppression proven at shot level, including the reload-in-flight edge case.

gotchas.summary: L5 'Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼ 20 for 10 sec' is own-cast-anchored in the prose but enacted as countInFb:30, which keys to the global Full Burst window — in multi-B3 comps the lowered threshold also applies during FB windows another B3 opened (~+1-2 extra 61.69% procs per foreign window, ~0.5-1% of her total), and the window is FB-anchored rather than cast-anchored (~0.3s offset). Exact in single-B3 scope.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Hit count required for Skill 2 ▼ 20 time(s) for 10 sec' (her own burst block). SSOT: 'countInFb overrides the threshold while a Full Burst window is live — keyed to the GLOBAL FB window... There is NO owner-anchored hitCount threshold primitive.' Driver: countInFb:30 with ⚑⚑ caveat + falsification recipe; S6 blind: same encoding + same ⚑ independently; S5 blind: it.skip on this exact ground; S2b: predicted as nearest-wrong model (a).
gotchas.suggestedFix: Keep countInFb:30 under the S4 engine freeze (best available; converged by all three derivations). Post-freeze, add an owner-anchored hitCount threshold primitive (mirror the existing chargeCounter lastBurstCastFrame+10s pattern) and re-key the line to it. Owner measurement recipe: in a two-B3 comp recording, count 61.69% popups during a foreign-B3 FB window — kit-true spacing is 50 hits, shipped spacing is 30.

verdictRationale: All 7 kit lines are modeled; 6 are FAITHFUL with frame-exact, independently re-derived pins (30-hit and 50/30 carry-over walks, per-cast buff frames, shot-level unlimited-ammo invariants) and live counterfactual arms that genuinely fail under each nearest-wrong model (trigger re-keys, threshold misreads, bucket swaps, dropped effects). The single divergence — burst L5's countInFb:30 being global-FB-keyed rather than own-cast-anchored — is a DOCUMENTED_GAP, not a gotcha: it was predicted by S2b, independently chosen with the same ⚑ by the S6 blind override-writer, independently refused-assertion by the S5 blind test-writer, bounded at ~0.5-1% in a two-B3 comp (exact at single-B3 scope), and unfixable without a new engine primitive that S4 froze; the override carries a concrete owner falsification recipe. Convergence: S5 blind tests run GREEN (27 + 1 intentional skip) against the shipped override, and S6 is structurally identical on all 7 lines (only a redundant explicit crit:true). Discrimination holds: every load-bearing test has a RED counterfactual, and the two-B3 control fixture really exercises the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter splits. The residual the owner should spot-check is the same-model convergence itself: driver, S5, and S6 all share the RRH prior that countInFb is the acceptable stand-in, so the one measurement worth spending is the foreign-B3-window popup count (50 vs 30 spacing) to confirm the kit truly is own-cast-anchored as all agents read it.
